scripts.stop: sh -c 'pids=$(lsof -tiTCP:3001 -sTCP:LISTEN); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then kill $pids 2>/dev/null || true; fi'
scripts.dev: npm run stop && rm -rf .next && next dev --turbo --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 3001
scripts.preview: npm run stop && rm -rf .next && next build && next start --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 3001
